title: ALMA Observations of Circumnuclear Disks in Early-type Galaxies: <SUP>12</SUP>CO(2-1) and Continuum Properties
question: What are the molecular gas (CO(2-1)) and continuum properties of circumnuclear dust disks in nearby early-type galaxies, and which are good candidates for ALMA black hole mass measurements?

data.sensitivity: ~400 uJy/beam per 20 km/s channel; ~40 uJy/beam continuum

what.value: Luminosity distances from surface brightness fluctuations

evidence.quote: Luminosity distance and uncertainties as measured from surface brightness fluctuations by (cite: mei00) and (cite: ton01)
Central stellar velocity dispersion from the HyperLeda database (cite: mak14)

what.value: R21 ~0.7 and alpha_CO = 3.1 from nearby late-type galaxies

evidence.quote: We convert our integrated CO(2$-$1) flux measurements into H$_2$ masses using average $R_{21}$ and $\alpha_{\rm CO}$ values from a sample of nearby, late-type galaxies (cite: san13)

recipe.goal: Image continuum and separate nuclear/extended components
recipe.method: Image continuum with natural and Briggs weighting, model and subtract point source in uv plane, re-image residual; reduce point-source flux until extended profile is monotonic
Image each continuum spw separately, subtract nucleus in uv plane, fit power law S_nu ~ nu^alpha at ~236 GHz

recipe.goal: Line profile fitting and kinematic maps
recipe.method: Gauss-Hermite fits per Voronoi-binned spectrum; uncertainties via 500 Monte Carlo resamplings
M_H2 = alpha_CO L'_CO with L'_CO from integrated flux; R21 ~0.7, alpha_CO = 3.1, helium factor 0.36
assumptions: R21 ~0.7; alpha_CO = 3.1; f_He = 0.36; disk thickness h ~0.1 R_d

recipe.method: Kinemetry on v_LOS maps; i = arccos(q_min); v_c ~ k1/sin i; enclosed mass within 2b or 5b
Q = c_s kappa/(pi G Sigma) with c_s replaced by minimum observed sigma_LOS and v_c from k1/sin i

evidence.quote: The unresolved 1.3 mm continuum spectral indices $\alpha_{\rm nuc}$ of our Cycle 2 sample range from $-0.44$ to 1.62
integrated absorption intensities $W_{\rm CO(2-1)}$ of $(19.4\pm2.5)$ and $(44.3\pm1.4)$ K km s$^{-1}$ for NGC 4374 and IC 4296
which span a relatively broad range of $\sim(1.5-8.8)\times10^9$ $M_\ensuremath{\odot}$

not_stated_but_needed: Image sizes, cell sizes and clean masks/thresholds per target
Line-free channels used for uv continuum subtraction
Self-calibration solution intervals and reference models
Exact CASA version assigned to each dataset
Kinemetry fitting settings (radial grid, harmonic orders)
Initial guesses for uv-plane point-source modeling
Which CASA task options were used (e.g. uvcontsub order, tclean parameters)
score_reason: Public data and clear recipe, but many imaging and fitting parameters are unstated.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric tables of masses, fluxes and spectral indices; recipe largely described though some parameters missing.
